_meta.purpose: Per-asset-class numeric conventions for the 2C grammar/normalizer. Consumed alongside lexicon-seed.json. The 2C dispatch: recognize product token via lexicon → look up its asset_class via the mapping → apply that asset_class's numeric rules to place decimals on each numeric token by grammar position (strike vs premium vs futures-price vs size vs ref).
_meta.source: Apurva's `product-specs/CME, ICE specs.md` (CME + ICE futures/options contract specs reference), grounded against authoritative exchange-spec pages.

ng.name: Natural Gas (Henry Hub benchmark)
ng.settlement: Physical delivery at Henry Hub, Louisiana (CME)
ng.notes: Benchmark NG product. Per CME/ICE spec table — see Section 2.1 of CME, ICE specs.md.

ng_basis.name: NG Basis (differential to Henry Hub or index)
ng_basis.contract_unit: 2,500 MMBtu (ICE typical, e.g. Eastern Gas South Basis)
ng_basis.options_strike_scale: small differential, often quoted in cents
exchanges: ICE — DOM (Eastern Gas South), many others
ng_basis.settlement: Cash-settled: Inside FERC index minus NYMEX HH last-day settle (LD1). Per live ICE Henry Basis Future spec: tick $0.0001/MMBtu, 2,500 MMBtu.
ng_basis.notes: Smaller tick than HH benchmark — 10× finer (0.0001 vs 0.001). Often quoted in CENTS (e.g. 'q3 waha/perm 22-24' = 22-24 cents differential). Sign convention: negative = trading at discount to HH.
ng_basis.sign: can be negative (discount to HH) or positive (premium) — preserve the spoken sign
ng_basis.cents_convention: often quoted in cents: 'twenty-two' = 0.2200, 'minus four and a half' = -0.045. Cents-vs-dollars is ambiguous.
ng_basis.needs_confirm: highest-ambiguity field in 2C (cents-vs-dollars + sign) → default basis price/strike to amber.
ng_basis.sibling_instruments: swing (daily, vs Gas Daily) and fixed-price (absolute regional, vs index) are recognized-not-verified.

oil.name: Crude Oil (WTI, Brent)
oil.settlement: Physical (CME CL) or cash (ICE Midland WTI HOU varies)
oil.notes: Critical NG-vs-WTI divergence: same spoken digits 'sixty-one' = 0.061 in NG premium position vs 0.61 in WTI premium position. 10× scale difference — the demo's gas-vs-oil 'aha' moment lives here. Brent/WTI arb sign convention: WTI - Brent (per IFEU §2.4).
oil.strike_notation: WTI strikes/prices CARRY the decimal in ICE Chat's recognized form: '62.50', '70.00', '57.33' — NOT the old YellowJacket no-decimal '6250'. The decimal is REQUIRED for ICE Chat to recognize the market (turn it blue/underlined). Confirmed by Apurva 2026-06-03 + ICE-support strings (e.g. 'WTI Sep25 57.33 / 57.35', 'WTI M25 54.50 Call').

refined.name: Refined Products (Heating Oil, RBOB Gasoline)
exchanges: CME (NYMEX) — HO (ULSD heating oil), RB (RBOB gasoline)
refined.notes: Used in crack-spread structures with crude and NG. Smaller per-tick value ($4.20) than NG/Oil/MMBtu products. Per Section 2.2 of CME, ICE specs.md.

power.name: Power (PJM, SP15, NEPOOL, MIDCO, NYPool, Palo, Cin)
power.contract_unit: 1 MW × hours in delivery block (monthly OR daily; peak OR off-peak)
exchanges: ICE — PJM WH, SP15, NEPOOL, MIDCO, etc.
power.settlement: Cash-settled vs ISO Day-Ahead LMP for the block (peak / off-peak / ATC)
power.notes: Daily AND monthly contracts. Block structure (peak / off-peak / ATC / 7x16 / 5x16) shapes vocabulary: 'mp'=monthly peak, 'mc'=monthly cash, 'dp'=daily peak, 'mth fence'=monthly fence. Tick value depends on hours in block (e.g., monthly peak = ~16h × 22 days = ~352 hours; tick value = 0.01 × 352 = $3.52). Per Section 3.4–3.5 of CME, ICE specs.md.

weather.name: Weather (HDD/CDD index futures & options)
weather.settlement: Cash-settled vs final HDD/CDD index calculated from weather-station data
weather.notes: HDD = winter (heating); CDD = summer (cooling). No physical delivery — pure index settlement. Per Section 2.3 of CME, ICE specs.md. Per-station: LGA / BOS / ORD / PHL / etc. each has its own contract.

venues._purpose: Optional venue/exchange routing tag for the 2C grammar. Orthogonal to asset_class — venue does NOT change decimal placement (NYMEX-HH and the ICE HH look-alike are numerically identical). Captured as a structured field and rendered as a NAME in both panes.

nymex.name: NYMEX
nymex.ng_contract: NG — physical delivery, 10,000 MMBtu/month, Henry Hub (Erath, LA) only, price-discovered; the NA benchmark
nymex.notes: Only 'NYMEX'/'CME' spoken. Bucket NN/HH/HP as 'NYMEX financial'. 'HH' collides with Henry Hub product — disambiguate by position.

ice.name: ICE
ice.lot_size: 2,500 MMBtu = ¼ NYMEX (ICE term 'quarter day', rarely spoken)
ice.fixed_price_future: cash-settled regional look-alike; dozens of hubs (SoCal-Border, Chicago, Henry Hub); settles vs index (Platts/NGI/NYMEX LD1) — e.g. SoCal Fixed Price vs NGI SoCal Border
ice.also_trades: basis futures (differential vs HH), swing futures (daily vs Gas Daily), spreads
ice.notes: Source: NA_Phys_Gas_Product_Codes.pdf + Apurva structural comparison 2026-06-01. Production reference; only venue/size/settlement facts pulled in. Phys-vs-financial kept quiet in output.

nodal.name: Nodal Exchange
nodal.notes: Power-leaning. Recognized per Apurva 2026-06-01; not a demo-verified standalone market.
